∀ {l : Filter NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.SpaceTime} {a : ℕ → ℕ} {h C hi r : ℝ},
  0 < h →
    h < 1 / 2 →
      ∀ (A : NavierStokes.BaseResidual.PhysicalApproach l h 0 hi),
        0 < r →
          ∀ {d : NavierStokes.SlowBorelBase.Coefficients},
            NavierStokes.SlowBorelBase.SmoothCoefficients d →
              NavierStokes.BaseResidual.StressZeroCore d r →
                NavierStokes.SlowBorelBase.AdmissibleScales h (NavierStokes.SlowBorelBase.coefficientBundle C d)
                    (NavierStokes.SlowBorelBase.innerBox 0 hi) a →
                  ∀ (f : NavierStokes.SlowExpansionResidual.SlowProfiles),
                    NavierStokes.BaseResidual.FiniteIdentities h C d f →
                      ∀ {O : Set NavierStokes.SlowBorelBase.Inner},
                        IsOpen O →
                          NavierStokes.SlowBorelBase.innerBox 0 hi ⊆ O →
                            ∀ (phi u beta : ℕ → NavierStokes.SlowBorelBase.Inner → ℝ),
                              (∀ (j : ℕ), ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (phi j) O) →
                                (∀ (j : ℕ), ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (u j) O) →
                                  (∀ (j : ℕ), ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (beta j) O) →
                                    (∀ (j : ℕ), ∀ w ∈ O, 0 ≤ w.1 → f.flux j w = w.1 * beta j w) →
                                      (∀ (j : ℕ), ∀ w ∈ O, 0 ≤ w.1 → f.axial j w = u j w) →
                                        (∀ (j : ℕ), ∀ w ∈ O, 0 ≤ w.1 → f.phi j w = phi j w) →
                                          (∀ w ∈ O, NavierStokes.CoordinateAlgebra.L h w.2 ≠ 0) →
                                            ∀ (m : ℕ) (n : ℝ),
                                              0 ≤ n →
                                                NavierStokes.DiagonalResidual.JetRate l
                                                  (fun (z : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.SpaceTime) =>
                                                    (NavierStokes.SlowBorelBase.cartesianChart h z).1)
                                                  (NavierStokes.BaseResidual.baseResidual a h C d) m n
